angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,166,146 km at 78.06 pc = 0.2 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.8110 +/- 0.0329 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 78.06 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.676 (1.642 to 1.710) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 1,166,146 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.118 (1.078 to 1.158) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5882 +/- 5 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 713135102814770432: teff_gspphot 5881.7 K (16th-84th percentiles 5879.7017-5889.759), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 713135102814770432: teff_gspphot 5881.7 K (16th-84th percentiles 5879.7017-5889.759), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/stribor.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.038, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 75898 (pscomppars): spectral type F8 V, from Ruggieri et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...689A.235R/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 75898: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 75898 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.29 dex, from Ruggieri et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...689A.235R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 75898 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.46, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 75898 (pscomppars): age 3.2 Gyr, from Ruggieri et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...689A.235R/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 75898 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4.2 km/s, from Ruggieri et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...689A.235R/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
